name: update-quest-system
description: Update quest-system to the latest version by running the install script (install is idempotent — same script installs and updates). Prefers a local finpack-claude clone, otherwise runs the allow-listed curl one-liner. The script self-cleans renamed/removed commands and agents via its manifest. Run after pulling finpack-claude updates. Requires quest-system to already be installed (/install-quest-system).
